postings.title: Graduate Program IT & Technology - Italy
postings.description:
Are you looking to kick off your career journey?

Do you like the idea of joining the European PayTech?

If so, you are at the right place!

Our Graduate Program offers you the chance to create your unique career path within our diverse international team, operating in more than 25 countries. Rotate among different departments, learn from experienced professionals, and make a difference by working on real business cases.

About the Program

Our Graduate Program is more than a learning path, it's a journey where you will work on real business cases and have a direct impact on business results.

What Can You Expect?

• Career Path: Start with a permanent contract from day one. Over 12 months, experience two rotations across departments and transition into a landing role where you can continue to grow.

• Training & Development: Receive a well-structured, dedicated Project Management training program, tailored to strengthen your ability to lead projects and deliver results. Plus, gain access to a wide range of learning opportunities through our Digital PayTech University, empowering you to continuously build your skills and expand your knowledge.

• Impact & Networking: Contribute to real business solutions and expand your network by working alongside talented colleagues and senior leaders from across Europe.

Who are We Looking For?

If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply:

• You have graduated within the past 12 months or will graduate within the next 6 months with a master’s degree in Engineering, STEM disciplines, Business, or related fields, and are available to work full-time.

• You are fluent in English and Italian.

• You bring international experience, whether through study, work abroad, or collaboration in a global environment.

• You are a career starter with no more than one year of professional experience.

• You have the legal right to work in Italy (e.g., residency, visa).

• You are committed, curious, and eager to take ownership of projects while thriving in a team environment.

• You see formal training as just the beginning and aim to make a difference in everything you do.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We are committed to building a diverse culture where talents from all walks of life feel they truly belong. By applying to our Graduate Program, you are one step closer to joining us. Next starts with you, everyday.

Apply Now!

Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity. Apply today and discover what's in it for you!

Please ensure both your CV and all answers in the application form are completed in English.

Are you interested in joining one of Europe's leading PayTech companies?

Do you want to be part of a diverse team, collaborating with colleagues from across Europe? If so, you're in the right place!

postings.title: Opportunità Nexi Group - Categorie Protette (Legge 68/99)
postings.description:
Categorie Protette (Legge 68/99) | Talent Pool & Future Opportunities at Nexi

Costruisci il futuro dei pagamenti con Nexi

Immagina un mondo in cui ogni transazione è semplice, sicura e connessa.
In Nexi, leader europeo nel PayTech, guidiamo questa trasformazione sviluppando strumenti e soluzioni che stanno ridefinendo i pagamenti digitali.

Se appartieni alle Categorie Protette (Legge 68/99) e desideri contribuire all’innovazione del settore in un ambiente dinamico, collaborativo e internazionale, questa potrebbe essere la tua prossima opportunità.

Il nostro impegno per l’inclusione

In Nexi crediamo fermamente nel valore della Diversity & Inclusion come leva strategica per l’innovazione e la crescita.
Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro aperto, rispettoso e inclusivo, che valorizza le competenze e le unicità di ogni persona, offrendo pari opportunità di sviluppo professionale.

Per rafforzare i nostri team, ricerchiamo persone appartenenti alle Categorie Protette (L.68/99) da inserire in diverse funzioni aziendali. Attraverso questa candidatura, entrerai nella nostra community di talenti e potrai essere preso in considerazione per opportunità attuali e future all'interno delle diverse aree aziendali.

Possibili aree di inserimento

In base al tuo background e alle tue competenze, potrai essere assunto in una delle seguenti aree:

- IT & Technology
- Sales & Merchant Services
- Finance
- Compliance & Risk
- Legal
- Corporate Functions

Entrerai a far parte di team cross-funzionali, avrai la possibilità di confrontarti con tecnologie avanzate e contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni che stanno trasformando il mercato dei pagamenti digitali.

Requisiti

- Appartenenza alle Categorie Protette (L.68/99)
- Diploma o Laurea (I o II livello), a seconda dell’area di interesse
- Buona conoscenza del pacchetto Office
- Preferibile la conoscenza della lingua inglese
- Curiosità, orientamento al risultato e attitudine al lavoro in team

Non è necessaria un’esperienza pregressa nel settore dei pagamenti: valutiamo con interesse anche candidature junior o con esperienze in altri ambiti.

RAL indicativa: €35.000 – €60.000 annui lordi. (La retribuzione annua lorda sarà commisurata all’esperienza e alle competenze del candidato.)

Il tuo next step inizia qui

Se pensi che questa possa essere l’opportunità professionale giusta per te, inviaci la tua candidatura oggi stesso.
Unisciti a Nexi e contribuisci a fare la differenza nel mondo dei pagamenti digitali, insieme!

Next starts with you, everyday.

postings.title: Product Manager - ECR (Electronic Cash Register)
postings.description:
What if your next job lets you simplify payments for millions, every single day?

Join Nexi and be part of a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can learn, grow, and make an impact everyday.

About Nexi
At Nexi, we're simplifying the future of digital payments. As one of Europe's leading payment companies, we combine international scale with the dynamism of a fast-moving tech company. With over 9,000 colleagues across more than 25 countries, we're shaping how people and businesses pay and interact every day. Here, your skills, curiosity, and ambition don't just support the business. They help shape what comes next.

Your Everyday at Nexi
We are seeking a talented and experienced Product Manager ECR specializing in Point of Sale (POS) systems, telematic cash registers, and retail management/fiscal software for the Italian market.

In this role based in Milan, you will be the key driver for the evolution of our product portfolio (software and/or hardware), leading the roadmap from inception to market launch. You will work closely with software development teams, hardware partners, legal/compliance departments, and marketing to ensure our solutions are not only innovative and user-friendly but also rigorously compliant.

About Your Future Role
In this position, you will:

1. Product Vision & Roadmap Definition

- Define, plan, and manage the product roadmap for POS systems and associated cloud/on-premise retail management software.
- Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into detailed technical specifications and user stories for the development teams.
- Continuously monitor the product lifecycle, defining and tracking key success metrics.

2. Fiscal Compliance & Integrations (Italy Focus)

- Actively monitor updates to Italian fiscal regulations regarding retail trade and large-scale distribution (e.g., Telematic Recorders/Registratori Telematici, XML daily transactional report transmissions, Receipt Lottery/Lotteria degli Scontrini, Electronic Invoicing, and POS/digital payment regulations).
- Collaborate with tax consultants and certification bodies to guarantee hardware and software compliance with the guidelines of the Italian Revenue Agency (Agenzia delle Entrate).
- Oversee the integration of POS software with key payment systems (EFT-POS), third-party ERPs, and e-commerce platforms to enable a seamless omnichannel experience.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration & UX/UI

- Partner closely with software engineering teams (Agile/Scrum) to ensure timely, high-quality releases.
- Work alongside UX/UI designers to optimize the checkout interface, ensuring fast, intuitive, and error-proof workflows for store operators (Retail, HoReCa, etc.).
- Support Sales, Customer Support, and Customer Success teams by providing training materials, technical documentation, and product demonstrations.

4. Market Analysis & Benchmarking

- Conduct market research to identify emerging trends in POS systems, smart checkout technologies, and digital payments.
- Perform competitive analysis on major POS and retail software players in the Italian market.

What We Value in You
We’re looking for someone eager to make a difference. Here’s what qualifications we value:

Technical Skills & Experience (Hard Skills):

- Experience: +7 years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner within the POS, retail/hospitality management software, or ERP solutions sector.
- Italian Fiscal Knowledge: Deep understanding of Italian fiscal compliance workflows (Telematic Recorders, XML transmission files for daily revenues, electronic invoicing via the SDI - Sistema di Interscambio).
- Hardware & IoT Experience (Preferred): Familiarity with managing the lifecycle of physical checkout devices (fiscal printers, POS terminals) and their communication protocols/drivers (e.g., Xon/Xoff, industry standards).
- Development Methodologies: Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product management tools (Jira, Confluence, Productboard).
- Data-driven Mindset: Proven ability to leverage quantitative and qualitative data to drive product decisions.

Interpersonal Skills (Soft Skills):

- Problem Solving & Precision: Exceptional attention to detail, which is critical when dealing with fiscal, accounting, and compliance logic.
- Communication & Leadership: Ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
- Customer Empathy: A strong focus on the end-user (cashier, merchant, store manager) to understand and solve their daily operational pain points.

Education & Languages:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.
- Languages: Native or fluent in Italian (essential for analyzing national fiscal laws and communicating with local authorities) and professional working proficiency in English (for collaboration with international partners or global tech teams).

What's in It for You?

Salary Range
Gross annual salary range: €60,000.00 – €80,000.00 + company bonus

- Benefits That Support You

- Hybrid work & flexibility: smart working policy, PTO and flexible working arrangements, remote working options during selected holiday closures
- Financial & wellbeing benefits: meal vouchers, public transport & carpooling support, gym membership benefits, private health insurance, mental wellbeing support, pension fund and access to the Nexi&Me employee benefits platform
- Family support: Parents & Caregivers policy, enhanced parental leave, domestic support, childcare and pet-sitting support, summer camp allowance
- Learning & development: PayTech University, professional development opportunities and internal mobility

Join an international team and grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Life and Culture at Nexi
Working at Nexi means collaborating across teams, markets, and disciplines to solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful results. You'll be part of an environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and teamwork are part of everyday life. Discover more about our culture, values, and what it's like to be part of Nexi on our Life at Nexi page.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment
At Nexi, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. By embracing differences and fostering respect, we build a culture where every individual has the opportunity to learn, grow, and succeed.

Next starts with you, everyday
At Nexi, our next idea, our next innovation, starts with you. Join us today.

Your Everyday at Nexi
As a Service Delivery Senior Specialist - ECR (Electronic Cash Register) , you’ll join a collaborative and forward-thinking team based in Milan.

About Your Future Role
In this position, you will:

- act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the activation and technical support processes of fiscal cash register solutions, including integration—where applicable—with fiscal cash registers, supporting accredited technician networks. Ensure continuous updates within Operations areas regarding industry fiscal developments and regulations.
- oversee network delivery activities with a strong focus on fiscal compliance, ensuring high service quality standards and managing, in a structured way, the collection, analysis, and resolution of operational and fiscal issues raised by customers and sales channels.
- oversee and coordinate technical and fiscal activities throughout installation and technical support processes, ensuring alignment between regulatory requirements, system configurations, and operational processes for maintenance and installation. Provide ongoing training both on fiscal cash registers and on management software used by advanced retail points (e.g., store management apps, inventory, invoicing, etc.).
- ensure high performance in training activities for end customers during service activation (installation) touchpoints and, where required, during maintenance activities.

What We Value in You
We’re looking for someone eager to make a difference. Here’s what we value:

Essential Qualifications:

- At least 5 years of experience in technical services related to fiscal cash registers, including management of local dealers and expertise in regulatory and procedural aspects of electronic cash registers.
- Knowledge of fiscal regulations related to electronic cash registers.
- Proven ability to manage complex integrations by coordinating and engaging multiple stakeholders.
- Good command of English (written and spoken).
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint).
- Ability to anticipate technical or commercial issues before they impact partners.
- Ability to effectively interact with internal technical teams.
- Results-oriented approach in dynamic and technologically advanced environments.
- Problem solving skills.

Even if you don’t check every box, your unique potential and willingness to learn could set you apart.

What's in It for You?

Salary Range
Gross annual salary range: €50,000.00 – €70,000.00 + company bonus

- Hybrid work & flexibility: smart working policy, PTO and flexible working arrangements, remote working options during selected holiday closures
- Financial & wellbeing benefits: meal vouchers, public transport & carpooling support, gym membership benefits, private health insurance, mental wellbeing support, pension fund and access to the Nexi&Me employee benefits platform
- Family support: Parents & Caregivers policy, enhanced parental leave, domestic support, childcare and pet-sitting support, summer camp allowance
- Learning & development: PayTech University, professional development opportunities and internal mobility

Join an international team and grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Life and Culture at Nexi
With over 9,000 colleagues across 25 countries, we're one international team driven by curiosity, ambition, and a passion for innovation. Discover our culture, our values, and how we're shaping the future of digital payments. Visit our Life at Nexi page.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment
At Nexi, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. By embracing differences and fostering respect, we build a culture where every individual has the opportunity to learn, grow, and succeed.

At Nexi, our next idea, our next innovation, starts with you. Join us today.

postings.title: SME Field Sales Specialist - Lazio
postings.description:
Costruisci il futuro dei pagamenti con Nexi

Immagina un mondo in cui ogni transazione è semplice, sicura e connessa. In Nexi, leader europeo nel PayTech, stiamo guidando questa trasformazione, costruendo strumenti e soluzioni che ridefiniscano le modalità di pagamento. Unisciti a noi e contribuisci a creare la prossima generazione di pagamenti digitali in un ambiente innovativo, collaborativo e internazionale.

Perché questa è la posizione giusta per te

Con il ruolo di SME Field Sales Specialist (Lazio), entrerai a far parte di un team dinamico che supporta le piccole e medie imprese nel loro percorso verso la digitalizzazione dei pagamenti. Il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto sulla crescita dei business locali, aiutandoli ad operare in modo efficiente e semplificando le transazioni quotidiane.

Il tuo ruolo

In questa posizione, ti occuperai di:

- Interagire con le PMI del territorio per comprenderne le esigenze e proporre le soluzioni Nexi più adatte.

- Gestire l’intero processo di vendita: dal primo incontro con il cliente fino all’attivazione completa, in linea con gli obiettivi di fatturato aziendali.

- Acquisire nuovi clienti nell’area di competenza.

- Presentare le soluzioni Nexi, riconosciute per affidabilità, semplicità e tecnologia innovativa, illustrandone funzioni e vantaggi.

- Monitorare appuntamenti, pipeline, performance commerciali e dati di vendita tramite strumenti CRM e sistemi di reporting.

- Analizzare KPI commerciali, trend di vendita e dati di territorio per identificare opportunità di business e ottimizzare le attività commerciali.

- Utilizzare dati e insight per supportare decisioni di vendita, migliorare le performance e contribuire alla pianificazione commerciale (forecast e pipeline management).

- Preparare report periodici sull’andamento delle attività commerciali, delle conversioni e dei risultati rispetto agli obiettivi assegnati.

- Contribuire a iniziative locali che rafforzano la presenza di Nexi nella regione.

- Garantire la soddisfazione dei clienti promuovendo al contempo il valore commerciale reciproco.

- Mantenere relazioni durature costruendo un rapporto di fiducia e di qualità con il cliente.

Cosa ti rende il candidato ideale

Cerchiamo una persona motivata, dinamica e pronta a mettersi in gioco, fortemente orientata alla vendita e con un approccio strutturato e data-driven.

Requisiti essenziali:

- Esperienza di 4+ anni in ruoli commerciali con conoscenza del tessuto delle PMI.
- Conoscenza del mercato locale e capacità di relazionarsi con diverse tipologie di interlocutori (ad esempio in ambito retail, ristorazione, alberghi, partite IVA, associazioni).
- Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali.
- Forte capacità analitica e attitudine all’utilizzo dei dati per monitorare performance commerciali, leggere KPI e individuare opportunità di business.
- Esperienza nell’utilizzo di CRM, strumenti di reporting e dashboard commerciali.
- Buona conoscenza di Excel e capacità di lavorare con analisi dati, metriche di vendita e reportistica strutturata.
- Capacità di interpretare dati commerciali, trend di mercato e performance di area a supporto delle decisioni operative e strategiche.
- Familiarità con elaborazione di offerte, business case e analisi di redditività.
- Interesse per i pagamenti digitali, la tecnologia o i servizi finanziari.
- Imprenditorialità, iniziativa e forte orientamento ai risultati.
- Flessibilità e disponibilità a viaggiare nel territorio di competenza.

Plus che fanno la differenza:

- Esperienza nel settore dei pagamenti o dei servizi/prodotti per il punto vendita nei settori retail.
- Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e in team.

Cosa offriamo

- Retribuzione competitiva, auto aziendale e buoni pasto.
- Formazione continua per aiutarti a raggiungere il tuo massimo potenziale professionale.
- Strumenti tecnologici avanzati per supportare il tuo successo - CRM, digital leads, kit tecnologico.
- Ambiente internazionale: oltre 9.000 colleghi in 25 Paesi Europei, per avere un focus internazionale rimanendo competitivi a livello locale
- Piano welfare aziendale completo e personalizzabile.
- Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, con coperture per infortuni e vita.
- Orario di lavoro flessibile, volto a favorire l’equilibrio tra vita personale e professionale.

Diversità e Inclusione

Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità: insieme, valorizziamo le nostre differenze per offrire un ambiente dove tutti sono in grado di esprimere al meglio il loro potenziale

Il tuo next step inizia qui

Inviaci la tua candidatura oggi stesso se ritieni che questa sia l’opportunità professionale giusta per te. Unisciti a Nexi per fare la differenza nel mondo dei pagamenti digitali, insieme!

Next starts with you, every day.
